name: Resolved
description: The underlying issue was corrected and the customer can proceed with no further action expected.

name: Workaround Provided
description: A temporary alternative allows the customer to proceed while the underlying issue remains open.

name: Escalated
description: The case was transferred to a specialist, engineering, product, billing, or another team for further action.

name: Information Provided
description: The request was answered with guidance or documentation and no system or account change was needed.

name: Duplicate Case
description: The same issue is already tracked in another support case or incident, so this case was linked to the existing record.

name: No Action Required
description: Review confirmed expected behavior, a false positive, a withdrawn request, or another situation where no change was needed.
